en.text: Saul was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned over Israel forty-two years.

footnotes.text: 13:1 The traditional Hebrew text omits “thirty” and “forty-”. The blanks are filled in here from a few manuscripts of the Septuagint.

zhSimplified.text: 扫罗登基年四十岁；作以色列王二年的时候，

zhTraditional.text: 掃羅登基年四十歲；作以色列王二年的時候，

en.text: Saul chose for himself three thousand men of Israel, of which two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in the Mount of Bethel, and one thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin. He sent the rest of the people to their own tents.

zhSimplified.text: 就从以色列中拣选了三千人：二千跟随扫罗在密抹和伯特利山，一千跟随约拿单在便雅悯的基比亚；其余的人扫罗都打发各回各家去了。

zhTraditional.text: 就從以色列中揀選了三千人：二千跟隨掃羅在密抹和伯特利山，一千跟隨約拿單在便雅憫的基比亞；其餘的人掃羅都打發各回各家去了。

en.text: Jonathan struck the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, “Let the Hebrews hear!”

zhSimplified.text: 约拿单攻击在迦巴的非利士人的防营，非利士人听见了。扫罗就在遍地吹角，意思说，要使希伯来人听见。

zhTraditional.text: 約拿單攻擊在迦巴的非利士人的防營，非利士人聽見了。掃羅就在遍地吹角，意思說，要使希伯來人聽見。

en.text: All Israel heard that Saul had struck the garrison of the Philistines, and also that Israel was considered an abomination to the Philistines. The people were gathered together after Saul to Gilgal.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列众人听见扫罗攻击非利士人的防营，又听见以色列人为非利士人所憎恶，就跟随扫罗聚集在吉甲。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列眾人聽見掃羅攻擊非利士人的防營，又聽見以色列人為非利士人所憎惡，就跟隨掃羅聚集在吉甲。

en.text: The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel: thirty thousand chariots, six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the seashore in multitude. They came up and encamped in Michmash, eastward of Beth Aven.

zhSimplified.text: 非利士人聚集，要与以色列人争战，有车三万辆，马兵六千，步兵像海边的沙那样多，就上来在伯·亚文东边的密抹安营。

zhTraditional.text: 非利士人聚集，要與以色列人爭戰，有車三萬輛，馬兵六千，步兵像海邊的沙那樣多，就上來在伯‧亞文東邊的密抹安營。

en.text: When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble (for the people were distressed), then the people hid themselves in caves, in thickets, in rocks, in tombs, and in pits.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列百姓见自己危急窘迫，就藏在山洞、丛林、石穴、隐密处，和坑中。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列百姓見自己危急窘迫，就藏在山洞、叢林、石穴、隱密處，和坑中。

en.text: Now some of the Hebrews had gone over the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead; but as for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

zhSimplified.text: 有些希伯来人过了约旦河，逃到迦得和基列地。扫罗还是在吉甲，百姓都战战兢兢地跟随他。

zhTraditional.text: 有些希伯來人過了約旦河，逃到迦得和基列地。掃羅還是在吉甲，百姓都戰戰兢兢地跟隨他。

en.text: He stayed seven days, according to the time set by Samuel; but Samuel didn’t come to Gilgal, and the people were scattering from him.

zhSimplified.text: 扫罗照着撒母耳所定的日期等了七日。撒母耳还没有来到吉甲，百姓也离开扫罗散去了。

zhTraditional.text: 掃羅照着撒母耳所定的日期等了七日。撒母耳還沒有來到吉甲，百姓也離開掃羅散去了。

en.text: Saul said, “Bring the burnt offering to me here, and the peace offerings.” He offered the burnt offering.

zhSimplified.text: 扫罗说：「把燔祭和平安祭带到我这里来。」扫罗就献上燔祭。

zhTraditional.text: 掃羅說：「把燔祭和平安祭帶到我這裏來。」掃羅就獻上燔祭。

en.text: It came to pass that as soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might greet him.

zhSimplified.text: 刚献完燔祭，撒母耳就到了。扫罗出去迎接他，要问他好。

zhTraditional.text: 剛獻完燔祭，撒母耳就到了。掃羅出去迎接他，要問他好。

en.text: Samuel said, “What have you done?” Saul said, “Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that you didn’t come within the days appointed, and that the Philistines assembled themselves together at Michmash,

zhSimplified.text: 撒母耳说：「你做的是什么事呢？」扫罗说：「因为我见百姓离开我散去，你也不照所定的日期来到，而且非利士人聚集在密抹。

zhTraditional.text: 撒母耳說：「你做的是甚麼事呢？」掃羅說：「因為我見百姓離開我散去，你也不照所定的日期來到，而且非利士人聚集在密抹。

en.text: therefore I said, ‘Now the Philistines will come down on me to Gilgal, and I haven’t entreated the favor of the LORD.’ I forced myself therefore, and offered the burnt offering.”

zhSimplified.text: 所以我心里说：恐怕我没有祷告耶和华。非利士人下到吉甲攻击我，我就勉强献上燔祭。」

zhTraditional.text: 所以我心裏說：恐怕我沒有禱告耶和華。非利士人下到吉甲攻擊我，我就勉強獻上燔祭。」

en.text: Samuel said to Saul, “You have done foolishly. You have not kept the commandment of the LORD your God, which he commanded you; for now the LORD would have established your kingdom on Israel forever.

zhSimplified.text: 撒母耳对扫罗说：「你做了糊涂事了，没有遵守耶和华—你 神所吩咐你的命令。若遵守，耶和华必在以色列中坚立你的王位，直到永远。

zhTraditional.text: 撒母耳對掃羅說：「你做了糊塗事了，沒有遵守耶和華－你上帝所吩咐你的命令。若遵守，耶和華必在以色列中堅立你的王位，直到永遠。

en.text: But now your kingdom will not continue. The LORD has sought for himself a man after his own heart, and the LORD has appointed him to be prince over his people, because you have not kept that which the LORD commanded you.”

zhSimplified.text: 现在你的王位必不长久。耶和华已经寻着一个合他心意的人，立他作百姓的君，因为你没有遵守耶和华所吩咐你的。」

zhTraditional.text: 現在你的王位必不長久。耶和華已經尋着一個合他心意的人，立他作百姓的君，因為你沒有遵守耶和華所吩咐你的。」

en.text: Samuel arose, and went from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. Saul counted the people who were present with him, about six hundred men.

zhSimplified.text: 撒母耳就起来，从吉甲上到便雅悯的基比亚。 扫罗数点跟随他的，约有六百人。

zhTraditional.text: 撒母耳就起來，從吉甲上到便雅憫的基比亞。 掃羅數點跟隨他的，約有六百人。

en.text: Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people who were present with them, stayed in Geba of Benjamin; but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.

zhSimplified.text: 扫罗和他儿子约拿单，并跟随他们的人，都住在便雅悯的迦巴；但非利士人安营在密抹。

zhTraditional.text: 掃羅和他兒子約拿單，並跟隨他們的人，都住在便雅憫的迦巴；但非利士人安營在密抹。

en.text: The raiders came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned to the way that leads to Ophrah, to the land of Shual;

zhSimplified.text: 有掠兵从非利士营中出来，分为三队：一队往俄弗拉向书亚地去，

zhTraditional.text: 有掠兵從非利士營中出來，分為三隊：一隊往俄弗拉向書亞地去，

en.text: another company turned the way to Beth Horon; and another company turned the way of the border that looks down on the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

zhSimplified.text: 一队往伯·和 去，一队往洗波音谷对面的地境向旷野去。

zhTraditional.text: 一隊往伯‧和崙去，一隊往洗波音谷對面的地境向曠野去。

en.text: Now there was no blacksmith found throughout all the land of Israel, for the Philistines said, “Lest the Hebrews make themselves swords or spears”;

zhSimplified.text: 那时，以色列全地没有一个铁匠；因为非利士人说，恐怕希伯来人制造刀枪。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，以色列全地沒有一個鐵匠；因為非利士人說，恐怕希伯來人製造刀槍。

en.text: but all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, each man to sharpen his own plowshare, mattock, ax, and sickle.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人要磨锄、犁、斧、铲，就下到非利士人那里去磨。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人要磨鋤、犂、斧、鏟，就下到非利士人那裏去磨。

en.text: The price was one payim each to sharpen mattocks, plowshares, pitchforks, axes, and goads.

footnotes.text: 13:21 A payim (or pim) was 2/3 shekel of silver, or 0.26 ounces, or 7.6 grams

zhSimplified.text: 但有锉可以锉铲、犁、三齿叉、斧子，并赶牛锥。

zhTraditional.text: 但有銼可以銼鏟、犂、三齒叉、斧子，並趕牛錐。

en.text: So it came to pass in the day of battle that neither sword nor spear was found in the hand of any of the people who were with Saul and Jonathan; but Saul and Jonathan his son had them.

zhSimplified.text: 所以到了争战的日子，跟随扫罗和约拿单的人没有一个手里有刀有枪的，惟独扫罗和他儿子约拿单有。

zhTraditional.text: 所以到了爭戰的日子，跟隨掃羅和約拿單的人沒有一個手裏有刀有槍的，惟獨掃羅和他兒子約拿單有。

en.text: The garrison of the Philistines went out to the pass of Michmash.

zhSimplified.text: 非利士人的一队防兵到了密抹的隘口。

zhTraditional.text: 非利士人的一隊防兵到了密抹的隘口。
